badges.name: Welcome!
badges.desc: Thanks for playing Miner's Haven!

badges.name: Getting Started
badges.desc: Place your first item.

badges.name: Stepping It Up
badges.desc: Buy Ore Incinerator furnace from the shop.

badges.name: Upgraded
badges.desc: Upgrade a single ore ten times.

badges.name: Millionaire
badges.desc: Obtain a million dollars.

badges.name: Trillionaire
badges.desc: Obtain a whopping trillion dollars.

badges.desc: Achieve a duodecillion dollars (That's ten with 38 zeros after it)

badges.desc: Reach life 1,000 and give it all up.

badges.name: Effortless
badges.desc: Rebirth with so much extra cash that you skip at least 3 lives.

badges.desc: You've achieved the impossible... you've broken the system. Get this badge when you rebirth with a Centillion (10^303) dollars.

badges.desc: You have completed the eternal journey,  and uncovered the knowledge of a new Enchant item.
